Hi Sarah — great to meet today, thanks for walking through your priority use cases. Per our call I attached a short pricing packet and a one-page estimate tailored to the throughput/latency targets you mentioned.

Quick recap of what we discussed:
- Goals: embed search + chat into product, 99th pct latency target <300ms for L1 requests, quarterly cost target for inference at scale.
- Data needs: VPC/private deployment preferred for PII use cases; SOC 2/audit evidence will be required during procurement.
- Next steps (proposed):
  1) I walk your team through the deck (20–30 min) and go over mixed routing options.
  2) If that looks good, we optionally loop Marcus (solutions engineer) for a technical deep dive and a quick perf estimate.
  3) Procurement/IT review for controls/contract language.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-olivetech.pdf, estimate-olivetech.xlsx (summary + line-item).

Would you be available for a 20–30 min walkthrough this week? I have Tue/Thu 10–11am PT open, or happy to send a couple of times that suit your calendar.

Thanks — happy to jump on whatever format helps.

—
